title: Elucidation of the two-step relaxation processes of a tetranuclear dysprosium molecular nanomagnet through magnetic dilution

synthesis.procedure: A methanolic solution (4.0 mL) of H2L (0.1 mmol, 29.8 mg) was neutralized with NaOH solution (2.0 mL, 0.05 mol L−1), and solid Dy(OAc)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 82.2 mg) was then added and stirred for 20 min at room temperature. The mixture was transferred to a 20 mL Teflon reactor, heated to 70 °C for 72 h under autogenous pressure, and cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1. Yellowish block crystals of 1 were obtained.
synthesis.time: stirred 20 min; heated 72 h; cooled at 5 °C h−1
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon reactor, solvothermal under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; yellowish block crystals isolated
synthesis.yield: 51.4 mg (57.9% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Ferromagnetic Dy–Dy interactions and two-step slow magnetic relaxation under zero dc field (SMM). Fast-relaxation Ueff = 38 K and slow-relaxation Ueff = 223 K (highest among reported tetranuclear Dy nanomagnets); butterfly hysteresis below 6 K.

measurements.name: chi_M T (300 K)
measurements.conditions: 2–300 K, 1 kOe; four uncoupled Dy3+ expected 56.68 cm3 mol−1 K

measurements.name: chi_M T (minimum)
measurements.conditions: 18 K; then rises below 18 K (ferromagnetic coupling)

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 50 kOe; non-superimposed M vs H/T at 2–10 K

measurements.name: hysteresis coercive field
measurements.conditions: 2 K, sweep rate 500 Oe s−1; remnant magnetization 0.19 Nβ; butterfly loops below 6 K

measurements.name: Ueff (fast relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius; tau0 = 1.2 × 10−7 s

measurements.name: Ueff (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Orbach/Raman/QTM fit; tau0 = 2.3 × 10−11 s; tau_QTM = 0.008 s; n = 4.93, C = 0.010 s−1 K−4.5

material_class.structural_family: isostructural centrosymmetric tetranuclear Y4 Schiff-base/acetate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same solvothermal procedure as 1, substituting Y(OAc)3·6H2O for Dy(OAc)3·6H2O: H2L (0.1 mmol) in methanol (4.0 mL) neutralized with NaOH (2.0 mL, 0.05 mol L−1), metal salt added, stirred 20 min, then heated in a 20 mL Teflon reactor at 70 °C for 72 h under autogenous pressure and cooled at 5 °C h−1.

reagents.name: yttrium(III) acetate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: used in place of Dy(OAc)3·6H2O (same procedure as 1)

synthesis.yield: 44.7 mg (60.2% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Diamagnetic yttrium analogue used as a structural/dilution host; no magnetic or optical measurements reported for 2 itself.

material_class.structural_family: magnetically diluted isostructural tetranuclear Schiff-base/acetate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Obtained by a method similar to 1, replacing Dy(OAc)3·6H2O with a mixture of Dy(OAc)3·6H2O and Y(OAc)3·6H2O in a 1 : 19 molar ratio (5% Dy feed). ICP found 6% Dy dilution. Same methanol/NaOH/solvothermal protocol as 1.

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) acetate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: molar ratio 1 : 19 vs Y salt (5% Dy in feed)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: same 20 mL Teflon solvothermal method as 1
synthesis.yield: 43.2 mg (55.4% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Diluted sample retains two ac relaxation processes; SR Ueff = 203 K comparable to 1, supporting single-ion origin. chi_M T falls to 48.50 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K without the low-T upturn of 1, consistent with weakened Dy–Dy exchange.

measurements.name: chi_M T (minimum)
measurements.conditions: 2 K; slow decline 300–100 K then faster fall below 100 K

measurements.name: Ueff (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius above 15 K; tau0 = 7.5 × 10−11 s
